phase: DIAGNOSIS_PLAN_ONLY; product edits await parent instruction
methodology_sources: Existing conversation revision/pending selection and immutable manifest/run bindings
Parent-verified official Anthropic effort/thinking troubleshooting, OpenAI gpt-6-luna, xAI reasoning docs (2026-10-28)

facts.general_chat: Anthropic-only; six allowlisted tools; per-round transmission consent and cost/rights checks
facts.reasoning: chat_models.body hardcodes low; general live sets thinking disabled and rejects unexpected private thinking
facts.preferences: No existing model-specific agent mode/effort preferences
facts.conversation_control: model_revision + server-bound pending selection already preserves current general turn; completion applies only matching reservation
facts.full_access: No existing safe distinct full-mode auto-apply behavior; cannot advertise a label-only mode
facts.delete: No account or file-delete model API; unknown tool/argument shape rejected; no need to create delete endpoints

options.name: Mode labels with only tool filtering
options.benefit: Smallest change; readonly can restrict to lookup
options.problem: Review and FullAccess remain behaviorally identical with current six tools; does not satisfy honest differentiated modes

options.name: Bounded FullAccess with versioned agent draft edits
options.benefit: Real mode difference without faking human approval or bypassing final output/cost/rights
options.details: readonly lookup only; review preserves current six-tool semantics; full permits only explicitly whitelisted reversible timeline edits to save a new unapproved draft with agent provenance. Motion proposals stay proposals until existing human source approval; render still requires real existing scoped grant.

options.name: Adaptive thinking plus broad autonomous internal tool execution
options.benefit: Could support Haiku xhigh/max and more agent actions
options.problem: Private thinking/signature/continuation/usage and broader permission policy require substantial separate contracts; exceeds minimal safe scope

recommended_contract.storage: Conversation-local per-model settings map with per-model revision, default review/low; do not change shared image/video settings or media approval fingerprint
recommended_contract.request: New exact conversation_agent_settings action with selected model, expected setting revision and exact mode/effort; normal conversation CAS; unknown models/values/fields rejected
recommended_contract.general_Haiku_xhigh_max: vendor supports them, current disabled-thinking path does not; show reason/unimplemented rather than silently coerce
recommended_contract.route_projection: Vendor-supported values distinct from runtime route/configuration/account verification. General route cannot execute OpenAI/xAI even if catalogued.
recommended_contract.frozen_request: Freeze effective selected-model settings/revision in new previews, runs and turns; message/count bodies and all continuations use same effective effort/mode; settings upgrades never broaden existing manifest/run
recommended_contract.active_setting_change: Effort/current model setting changes become pending for the next new logical turn; never rewrite approved or submitted bodies. Keep cancellation/unknown pending recovery explicit.
recommended_contract.security_decision_needed: Permission downgrade can either wait for current logical turn or immediately intersect current write permission. Recommend immediate write revocation while keeping message/effort frozen; widening only on new confirmed turn. Parent must choose before implementation.
invariants: Account deletion prohibited in every mode
File/asset/project deletion needs target-specific explicit user permission; currently unsupported, no new delete APIs
Full mode is not cost/rights/transmission/final-output approval
Agent auto-apply must never call human review as local-owner or create source/output grant
Default review behavior and old snapshots/approvals preserved

app.py (scoped action and state projection only; preserve current static registrations)
chat_general.py (freeze settings into binding/manifest/run/turn, filter tools, continuation checks)
chat_models.py (validated model-specific effort body argument; no prices/client changes)
production_tools.py (server permission gate for direct/general/legacy routes)
optional_file_not_needed: model_selection.py can remain unchanged if dynamic capability lives in agent_preferences projection

Actual synthetic low/medium/high message/count/continuation body differences and model mapping; invalid Haiku xhigh/max and vendor-specific none/max rejection
Old preview/run cannot gain permissions; idle stale preview blocks; in-flight request body and pending next selection remain exact

Cancel/timeout/outcome_unknown and server restart preserve settings and pending intent without retransmission
